description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git operations related to the 'read-tree' functionality, including setup, execution, and verification of various test cases involving Git's index and tree states.

methods.name: maketree
methods.description: Creates a new Git tree with specified file structure and tags it with the given name.

methods.name: settree
methods.description: Resets the Git index to a specified tree object and checks out all files.

methods.name: checkindex
methods.description: Compares the current Git index state against expected output.
